title: Reading on a background thread, and the list that stutters

videos.script:
A phone redraws its screen sixty times a second, or more. {{budget}} Every frame is drawn on one thread, the main thread, and it has sixteen milliseconds to do it. A query that runs there spends that budget.

You will watch that happen. {{blocking}} A slow query on the main thread, and a timer standing in for the screen. While the query runs, not one frame is drawn.

Then the same query on a worker thread. {{worker}} It takes just as long, and the screen keeps drawing, because the main thread is no longer the one waiting. Room, SwiftData and Expo each have their own name for that arrangement.

And last, the list itself. {{paging}} Page three hundred and one, asked for by offset, walks fifteen thousand rows to return fifty. Asked for by key, it walks fifty. And when a sync slips one row in between two pages, the offset page shows you a row twice.
